lines.trans: Two firm pillows under your heel, Mei, and strict orders not to touch the floor.
Fine, fine—if I cannot stand at the stove, listen carefully to my kitchen rules!
Clipboard ready, Chef Mei! Who gets the six-o'clock bread dough?
Peng has strong shoulders—he kneads the morning dough while I watch the timer.
Deal! I used to help my grandmother knead Sunday loaves every week.
And who whisks the lemon curd and chops carrots for the lentil soup?
You whisk the lemons at my elbow, Qing, and Hao chops every vegetable to the millimetre!

words.gloss: right at hand; at one's elbow

lines.trans: Believe me, Hao will measure every carrot cube with a ruler!
What job do we give Manager Zhou so he feels helpful without breaking anything?
Polishing the twelve white cups at the table—far away from switches and paint!
Now drink this chamomile tea and go rest upstairs, Mei.
Wake me at six sharp—nobody touches my oven without me in that chair!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

丁.gloss: diced cube; small cube of food

meanings.en: diced cube; small cube of food
meanings.note: Pinyin: dīng. In cooking, denotes small even cubes (菜丁 'diced vegetables', 胡萝卜丁 'diced carrots'); measure word: 颗 (kē) or 粒 (lì).

examples.text: 志豪把每一颗胡萝卜丁都切得大小一样。
examples.trans: Hao cut every single diced cube of carrot to the exact same size.

examples.text: 先把洋葱切成小丁，再放进热橄榄油里慢慢炒香。
examples.trans: Dice the onion into small cubes first, then sauté it gently in warm olive oil until fragrant.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng lóu. Verb-object compound meaning 'climb/go to an upper floor'.

examples.text: 先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
examples.trans: Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.

examples.text: 他上楼之前把蔬菜汤喝得一干二净。
examples.trans: Before going upstairs, he drank every last drop of the vegetable soup.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù néng. Modal negation expressing inability or prohibition ('cannot / must not'); bù stays 4th tone before 2nd-tone néng.

examples.text: 油漆还没干，现在不能坐在椅子上。
examples.trans: The paint is not dry yet, so you cannot sit on the chairs right now.

examples.text: 修电线的时候千万不能开总开关。
examples.trans: You must not turn on the main switch while repairing electrical wires.

meanings.note: strict modal expression prohibiting an action

examples.text: 不是说过实习生不许进总编室吗？
examples.trans: Did you not say interns are not allowed inside the chief editor's office?

examples.text: 录影开始以后不许随便走动。
examples.trans: Once taping begins, walking around freely is not allowed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōng xi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个东西 ('a thing / item').

examples.text: 深呼吸，周经理。还没人写任何东西呢。
examples.trans: Take a deep breath, Manager Zhou. Nobody has written anything yet.

examples.text: 白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
examples.trans: What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yán jìn. Formal compound 严 ('strictly') + 禁 ('forbid/prohibit'), common on public signs and used playfully for strict household or kitchen rules.

examples.text: 小美脚后跟底下垫着两个枕头，今天严禁沾地！
examples.trans: Mei has two pillows propped under her heel and is strictly forbidden to touch the floor today!

examples.text: 为了保护八十年的老木头地板，阳光房里严禁乱扔烟头。
examples.trans: To protect the eighty-year-old wooden floor, littering or smoking is strictly forbidden in the sunroom.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔ chú. Combines 主 ('chief/head') + 厨 ('cook/kitchen'); measure word: 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 小美主厨坐在两个枕头上，用木勺指挥整个厨房。
examples.trans: Head Chef Mei sat propped on two pillows, directing the whole kitchen with a wooden spoon.

examples.text: 这位年轻的主厨最擅长烤酥脆的杏仁柠檬挞。
examples.trans: This young head chef specializes in baking crisp almond lemon tarts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǐ xì. Describes checking details or listening closely.

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

examples.text: 出门前请仔细检查一下门锁。
examples.trans: Please check the door lock carefully before going out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular masculine pronoun; pronounced identically to 她 and 它.

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ qián. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 以前的日子 ('days in the past').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 哦？您家里人以前住在这附近吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Did your family live near here once?

related.gloss: days in the past (measure word 段)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiū xi. Everyday verb for resting after a trip or shift.

examples.text: 您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
examples.trans: Rest well, ma'am; ring the bell anytime if you need anything.

examples.text: 您的房间准备好了，请上楼休息吧。
examples.trans: Your room is ready; please head upstairs and rest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huì. Expresses either an acquired skill (会弹钢琴) or likelihood in the future (会下雨).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liù. Cardinal number 6.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě zì bǎn. Combines 写字 ('write characters') + 板 ('board'); measure word: 块 (kuài) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 志鹏拿起写字板笑道：“写字板准备好了，小美主厨请下令吧！”
examples.trans: Picking up the clipboard, Peng grinned: 'Clipboard ready—give your orders, Chef Mei!'

examples.text: 小晴把星期三的检查清单夹在写字板上，逐条核对。
examples.trans: Qing clipped Wednesday's checklist onto the writing board and checked off each item.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔn bèi. Used for preparing rooms, breakfast, or plans.

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng rǔ. Combines 凝 ('congeal/set into a smooth custard') + 乳 ('milk/creamy emulsion'); 柠檬凝乳 is the culinary term for lemon curd.

examples.text: 要是我坐在椅子上休息，明天早上的柠檬凝乳谁来熬呢？
examples.trans: If I sit resting in a chair, who will cook tomorrow morning's lemon curd?

examples.text: 用新鲜蛋黄和柠檬汁慢火熬出的柠檬凝乳又香又滑。
examples.trans: Lemon curd cooked slowly over low heat with fresh egg yolks and lemon juice is fragrant and silky.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiē. Used for slicing bread, cake, fruit, or vegetables with a knife.

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 刚出炉的：星期五柠檬蛋糕，多切了边角！
examples.trans: Fresh from the oven: Friday lemon cake, with extra corner pieces!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí èr. Cardinal number 十 ('ten') + 二 ('two').

examples.text: 阳光房里一共可以摆十二把木椅。
examples.trans: Twelve wooden chairs in all can be arranged in the sunroom.

examples.text: 一年有十二个月。
examples.trans: There are twelve months in a year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chú fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间厨房 ('a kitchen').

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Read zhǐ as the adverb 'only' before verbs, and zhī as a measure word for cups, boxes, and small animals.

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào xǐng. Resultative verb compound 叫 ('call') + 醒 ('awake').

examples.text: 明天早上五点半叫醒我——六点整我们在厨房集合！
examples.trans: Wake me up at five-thirty tomorrow morning—we meet in the kitchen at six sharp!

examples.text: 清晨院子里的小鸟叫声把大家都温柔地叫醒了。
examples.trans: The birdsong in the courtyard at dawn gently woke everyone up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hē. Used for drinking tea, coffee, water, juice, AND soup in Mandarin (喝汤).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Means both 'sit down' (请坐) and 'ride inside a vehicle' (坐火车 'take the train').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

块.gloss: measure word for pieces and yuan

meanings.en: measure word for pieces and yuan
meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. Counts chunks/pieces (一块蛋糕 'a piece of cake') and spoken yuan of money (五块钱 'five yuan').

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn. Verb meaning to place a pillow, pad, or mat underneath something to raise or cushion it (垫着靠垫 'propped on a cushion').

examples.text: 小美在厨房门口垫着软靠垫，自豪地看完了全过程。
examples.trans: Propped on a soft cushion at the kitchen doorway, Mei proudly watched the whole process.

examples.text: 热汤锅端上木桌以前，记得先在下面垫一块厚竹垫。
examples.trans: Before setting the hot soup pot on the wooden table, remember to put a thick bamboo mat underneath.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎi nai. Reduplicated kinship noun; second syllable is neutral tone; also used respectfully for elderly women; measure word: 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 志鹏说他以前每个星期天都帮奶奶揉面烤甜面包。
examples.trans: Peng said he used to help his grandmother knead dough and bake sweet bread every Sunday.

examples.text: 住在巷子口的陈奶奶最喜欢喝小美熬的热扁豆汤。
examples.trans: Grandma Chen at the end of the lane loves drinking the hot lentil soup Mei simmers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 这是好吧啊。
examples.trans: This is okay.

examples.text: 那个好吧好。
examples.trans: That okay is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān pái. Used as both verb ('arrange a room') and noun ('an arrangement').

examples.text: 我在做梦吗？！志豪，这场重逢是你安排的吗？
examples.trans: Am I dreaming?! Zhihao, did you plan this whole reunion?

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǐ zi. Combines 尺 ('measuring rule / Chinese foot') + noun suffix 子; measure word: 把 (bǎ).

examples.text: 志鹏开玩笑说，志豪真会拿一把尺子去量每一颗胡萝卜丁！
examples.trans: Peng joked that Hao really would take a ruler to measure every single cube of diced carrot!

examples.text: 挂欢迎木牌以前，老陈先用尺子量好了门框两边的高度。
examples.trans: Before hanging the welcome sign, Chen used a ruler to measure the height on both sides of the doorframe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāng. Everyday verb for helping someone (帮我一下 'give me a hand').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

帮上.gloss: manage to help; be of help

meanings.en: manage to help; be of help
meanings.note: Pinyin: bāng shàng. Resultative verb compound 帮 ('help') + 上 ('achieve/manage to'), often with object 忙 (帮上忙 'be of real help').

examples.text: 我们给周经理安排什么活，才能让他觉得自己帮上了忙呢？
examples.trans: What job can we give Manager Zhou so that he feels he really helped out?

examples.text: 多亏志豪今天早上在厨房一起切菜，真是帮上了大忙。
examples.trans: Thanks to Hao chopping vegetables in the kitchen this morning, he was a huge help.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐ xia. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最底下 ('the bottom').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi guān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个开关 ('a switch').

examples.text: 周经理，等一分钟，先别碰那个铜开关。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, wait a minute—don't touch that brass switch yet.

examples.text: 老板，这是三十年的老电线。我检查以前，千万别按开关。
examples.trans: Boss, this wire is thirty years old. Never flip a switch before I check it.

meanings.note: Verb guī ('come under someone's charge; return').

examples.text: 从今以后，二部的人归一部现场组管。
examples.trans: From now on, Unit Two staff report to Unit One's floor team.

examples.text: 这间素材房归行政部门管理。
examples.trans: This archive room is managed by administration.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: máng. Describes a busy person, morning, or shop.

examples.text: 啊！忙着行李箱、热水器和来信，我完全忘了！
examples.trans: Oh! With the suitcases, the water heater, and the letter, I completely forgot!

examples.text: 早上前台总是特别忙。
examples.trans: The front desk is always especially busy in the morning.

meanings.note: Exclamation sealing a bet, promise, or transaction.

examples.text: 一言为定，咱们就这么愉快地成交了！
examples.trans: Word is bond—consider it a deal!

examples.text: 双方谈妥条件，很快就签字成交了。
examples.trans: Once terms were agreed, both sides signed and sealed the deal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: biǎn dòu. Literally 扁 ('flat') + 豆 ('bean/legume'), used for flat-podded beans and lentils.

examples.text: 加了柠檬和橄榄油的金黄扁豆汤又香又暖胃。
examples.trans: Golden lentil soup with lemon and olive oil is fragrant and warming.

examples.text: 小美前一天晚上先把扁豆洗干净泡好。
examples.trans: Mei washed and soaked the lentils the night before.

手边.gloss: right at hand; at one's elbow

meanings.en: right at hand; at one's elbow
meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu biān. Place noun 手 ('hand') + 边 ('side'): within immediate arm's reach.

examples.text: 小美说切胡萝卜和洋葱可以在她手边的桌子上做。
examples.trans: Mei said chopping the carrots and onions can be done on the table right at her elbow.

examples.text: 修钢琴的时候，老陈喜欢把镊子和扳手都整齐地放在手边。
examples.trans: When repairing a piano, Chen likes keeping his tweezers and wrench neatly within reach.

meanings.note: Verb-complement dǎsuì ('smash, break apart').

examples.text: 他一次次把我的天真幻想打碎。
examples.trans: Again and again he shattered my naive illusions.

examples.text: 不小心打碎杯子要马上收拾干净。
examples.trans: Clean up right away if you accidentally break a glass.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ná. Core verb for holding or fetching objects in the hand.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

揉.gloss: rub, knead (figurative in 眼里揉不进沙子)

meanings.en: rub, knead (figurative in 眼里揉不进沙子)
meanings.note: Used literally ('rub eyes') or in the idiom for zero tolerance of deceit.

examples.text: 熬夜剪片子眼睛发酸，她轻轻揉了揉眼角。
examples.trans: With tired eyes from overnight editing, she rubbed the corners gently.

examples.text: 董事长向来眼里揉不进沙子，绝不容忍账目造假。
examples.trans: The chairwoman tolerates zero grit in her eye and brooks no fake accounts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo. Action verb for stirring liquids, sauces, or batters with a spoon or whisk.

examples.text: 小晴开着小火不停地搅，不让锅底的柠檬酱煮开。
examples.trans: Qing stirred nonstop over low heat so the lemon curd at the bottom of the pot wouldn't boil.

examples.text: 喝热红茶的时候，他喜欢放一小勺蜂蜜轻轻搅一下。
examples.trans: When drinking hot black tea, he likes adding a small spoonful of honey and giving it a gentle stir.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cā. Used for wiping tables, drying water, or polishing lanterns.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng. Combines with a measure word to mean 'the entire' (整条街 'the whole street', 整栋楼 'the whole building').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

meanings.note: Pinyin: páng. Compact locality noun placed after nouns (钢琴旁 'beside the piano', 窗旁 'by the window').

examples.text: 宋老师正坐在阳光房的钢琴旁微笑呢。
examples.trans: Teacher Song is sitting beside the piano in the sunroom smiling.

examples.text: 客栈大门旁挂着一块擦得发亮的铜牌。
examples.trans: Beside the inn's front gate hangs a brightly polished brass plaque.

meanings.note: Correlative conjunction jì ('both ... and ...').

examples.text: 这样做既能体现价值，又很务实。
examples.trans: Doing this both reflects values and stays practical.

examples.text: 这位主持人既幽默又专业。
examples.trans: This host is both witty and professional.

examples.text: 既然来了。
examples.trans: Since arrived.

examples.text: 既然如此。
examples.trans: Since it is so.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个早上 ('a morning').

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Friendly workplace farewell míngtiān jiàn.

examples.text: 我先走了，明天见！
examples.trans: I am heading off, see you tomorrow!

examples.text: 大家辛苦了，明天见！
examples.trans: Great work everyone, see you tomorrow!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个星期天 ('a Sunday').

examples.text: 从那个星期天起我们再也没说话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that Sunday we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 星期天早上大家都不急着赶车，慢慢喝早茶。
examples.trans: On Sunday mornings nobody rushes for trains, lingering over tea instead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu jìn. Literally 有 ('have') + 劲 ('strength/vigour/drive'); describes strong arms/shoulders or lively musical tone.

examples.text: 志鹏肩膀很有劲，明天早上六点的面包面团就交给他揉了！
examples.trans: Peng has strong shoulders, so tomorrow morning's six-o'clock bread dough goes to him to knead!

examples.text: 修好后的钢琴每一个低音听起来都沉稳又有劲。
examples.trans: Every bass note on the repaired piano sounds steady and full of vigour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

杯.gloss: measure word for cups and glasses

meanings.en: measure word for cups and glasses
meanings.note: Pinyin: bēi. Counts cups of tea, coffee, water, or juice (一杯热茶 'a cup of hot tea').

examples.text: 太客气了，周经理。半杯就好。
examples.trans: How polite of you, Manager Zhou. Half a glass is fine.

examples.text: 坐下吧，小晴！早上你跑了半条街，喝杯咖啡。
examples.trans: Sit down, Qing! You ran half the street this morning—drink a cup of coffee.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěn tou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个枕头 ('a pillow').

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng méng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个柠檬 ('a lemon').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

meanings.note: Classifier yàng ('kind, type of thing').

examples.text: 世上有两样东西是管不住的。
examples.trans: Two things in this world cannot be controlled.

examples.text: 桌上有好几样点心。
examples.trans: There are several kinds of snacks on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō zi. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张桌子 ('a table').

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ zi. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把椅子 ('a chair').

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: háo mǐ. Metric unit taking numbers directly without 个.

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 一定看准里面铜圈是二十毫米宽。
examples.trans: Make sure the brass ring inside is twenty millimetres wide.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tāng. Measure word (量词): 碗 (wǎn), e.g. 一碗汤 ('a bowl of soup').

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

related.gloss: a bowl of soup (measure word 碗)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yóu qī. Measure word (量词): 桶, e.g. 一桶油漆 ('a bucket of paint').

examples.text: 一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
examples.trans: Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.

examples.text: 木门上的蓝油漆还是去年新刷的。
examples.trans: The blue paint on the wooden door was freshly brushed on last year.

related.gloss: a bucket of paint (measure word 桶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhān dì. Separable verb-object compound 沾 ('lightly touch/contact') + 地 ('ground/floor'), usually negated (不沾地 / 严禁沾地).

examples.text: 志鹏把两个结实的枕头垫在小美脚下，宣布今天右脚严禁沾地。
examples.trans: Peng tucked two firm pillows under Mei's foot and declared her right foot strictly forbidden to touch the floor today.

examples.text: 忙了一整个早上，小晴在厨房和前厅之间跑得脚不沾地。
examples.trans: Busy all morning, Qing hurried between the kitchen and front hall so fast her feet barely touched the floor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yáng gān jú. Botanical compound 洋 ('Western/introduced') + 甘 ('sweet') + 菊 ('chrysanthemum/daisy'): soothing chamomile flowers brewed as herbal tea.

examples.text: 小美请小晴去泡三大壶热茶：薄荷茶、洋甘菊茶和红茶。
examples.trans: Mei asked Qing to brew three big pots of hot tea: mint, chamomile, and black tea.

examples.text: 晚上睡觉以前喝一杯温热的洋甘菊茶，整个人都会安静下来。
examples.trans: Drinking a warm cup of chamomile tea before bed helps you wind down peacefully.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huó. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件活儿 ('a piece of work').

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

examples.text: 手里的活做完就可以休息了。
examples.trans: Once we finish the work in hand, we can rest.

related.gloss: a piece of work (measure word 件)

meanings.note: Pinyin: lú zi. Combines 炉 ('stove/furnace') + nominal suffix 子 (zi); measure word: 台 (tái) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 小美！你看你，两只脚稳稳站在炉子前了！
examples.trans: Mei! Look at you standing steady in front of the stove on both feet!

examples.text: 炉子上的大铁锅里正咕嘟咕嘟煮着红扁豆汤。
examples.trans: In the big pot on the stove, red lentil soup is simmering away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎo xiāng. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台烤箱 ('an oven').

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经放进去了。
examples.trans: My dough is already in the oven, at least.

examples.text: 宋老师早！我的肉桂卷刚出烤箱。
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! My cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn zài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 现在这时候 ('this moment right now').

examples.text: 现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
examples.trans: For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

related.gloss: this moment right now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: cí bēi. Combines 瓷 ('porcelain/china') + 杯 ('cup'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 我们让周经理负责把十二个白瓷杯擦得闪闪发亮。
examples.trans: Let's put Manager Zhou in charge of polishing all twelve white porcelain teacups until they gleam.

examples.text: 洁白的瓷杯里盛着翠绿的薄荷茶，看起来格外清雅。
examples.trans: Bright green mint tea inside a white porcelain cup looks wonderfully refined.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn dēng. Combines 电 ('electricity') + 灯 ('lamp/light'); measure word: 盏 (zhǎn).

examples.text: 我们请周经理明天负责检查九号房的每一盏电灯和每一个开关。
examples.trans: We asked Manager Zhou to take charge of checking every electric light and switch in Room Nine tomorrow.

examples.text: 傍晚六点，走廊和院子里的暖黄色电灯一盏接一盏亮了起来。
examples.trans: At six in the evening, the warm yellow electric lights in the hallway and courtyard came on one after another.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái. Describes white paper, sugar, or tablecloths.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng xìn. Used for trusting people or believing news.

examples.text: 真不敢相信您也住在这家客栈，宋老师。
examples.trans: I can hardly believe you are staying at this very same inn, Teacher Song.

examples.text: 我相信你们一定能把咖啡馆办好。
examples.trans: I believe you will definitely run a wonderful café.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pèng. Used for touching objects or running into someone (碰到 'bump into').

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

examples.text: 我在街口正好碰到了老邻居。
examples.trans: I happened to run into an old neighbor at the corner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lí. Frames distance between two places or times: A 离 B 很近 ('A is close to B').

examples.text: 把小木桌放在树下面吧，离门口远一点。
examples.trans: Let's put the small wooden table right under the tree, a little farther from the doorway.

examples.text: 客栈离火车站只有十分钟路。
examples.trans: The inn is only ten minutes away from the train station.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. As a verb, 'stand' (站在旁边); as a noun, 'station/stop' (火车站).

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng què. Combines 精 ('fine/meticulous') + 确 ('accurate/exact').

examples.text: 切胡萝卜丁和洋葱丁需要精确的刀工，交给建筑师志豪最合适了！
examples.trans: Dicing carrots and onions calls for precise knife work, making architect Hao the ideal person for the job!

examples.text: 钟表匠修理齿轮的时候，每一个动作都非常精确。
examples.trans: When a watchmaker repairs gears, every single movement is remarkably precise.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē shi. Note first tone jiē + neutral shi ('solidly built').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 好位置。两把结实椅子，朝着花草，别朝着大堂窗户。
examples.trans: Good spot. Two sturdy chairs, facing the plants rather than the lobby window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiān bǎng. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双肩膀 ('shoulders').

examples.text: 挺起肩膀，志豪先生。记住那三句简单的话——我去开门！
examples.trans: Shoulders back, Mr Zhihao. Remember those three simple lines—I will open the gate!

examples.text: 哥哥笑着拍了拍弟弟的肩膀。
examples.trans: Smiling, the older brother patted his younger brother's shoulder.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hú luó bo. Combines 胡 ('introduced via Central Asia/Silk Road') + 萝卜 ('radish/root vegetable'); final syllable is neutral tone; measure word: 根 (gēn).

examples.text: 志豪菜板上的每一颗胡萝卜丁都切得一模一样。
examples.trans: Every single cube of diced carrot on Hao's chopping board is cut identically.

examples.text: 把胡萝卜和洋葱用橄榄油炒香，煮出来的红扁豆汤颜色金黄。
examples.trans: Sautéing carrots and onions in olive oil gives the simmered red lentil soup a golden glow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo hòu gēn. Compound 脚 ('foot') + 后跟 ('back heel'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 志鹏在小美的脚后跟底下垫了两个结实的枕头，让她舒服地靠着。
examples.trans: Peng propped two firm pillows beneath Mei's heel so she could rest comfortably.

examples.text: 穿新皮鞋走远路的时候，要注意别磨破了脚后跟。
examples.trans: When walking a long way in new leather shoes, be careful not to blister your heels.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯茶 ('a cup of tea').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

related.gloss: a cup of tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū cài. Measure word (量词): 盘, e.g. 一盘蔬菜 ('a dish of vegetables').

examples.text: 他上楼之前把蔬菜汤喝得一干二净。
examples.trans: Before going upstairs, he drank every last drop of the vegetable soup.

examples.text: 早市刚买回来的绿叶蔬菜特别新鲜。
examples.trans: The leafy vegetables just bought at the morning market are super fresh.

related.gloss: a dish of vegetables (measure word 盘)

meanings.note: Pinyin: guī ju. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条规矩 ('a house rule').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 老茶馆有个好规矩：进门先送一杯热茶。
examples.trans: Old teahouses have a warm custom: a hot cup of tea right as you walk in.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jué de. Introduces personal impressions or feelings.

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 我觉得这间向阳的书房最安静。
examples.trans: I think this sunny study is the quietest room of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì shí qì. Compound 计时 ('count/measure time') + 器 ('instrument/device'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 先别掉眼泪，我的厨房面包计时器叮铃铃响了！
examples.trans: Don't shed tears just yet—my kitchen bread timer just rang!

examples.text: 小美把烤箱旁边的计时器定在三十五分钟，提醒志鹏准时取面包。
examples.trans: Mei set the timer beside the oven for thirty-five minutes to remind Peng to take the bread out on time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí. Question pronoun for people; stays in the exact spot of the answer (这是谁的？ 'Whose is this?').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

远远.gloss: from afar; by a wide margin

meanings.en: from afar; by a wide margin
meanings.note: Pinyin: yuǎn yuǎn. Reduplication of 远 ('far/distant'), functioning adverbially before verbs (远远超出 'far exceed', 远远看见 'spot from afar').

examples.text: 多亏老陈的巧手，这台老钢琴现在的音色远远超出了我的希望！
examples.trans: Thanks to Chen's skilled hands, the tone of this old piano now far exceeds my hopes!

examples.text: 走在梧桐巷口，远远就能闻到九号房飘出的柠檬挞香气。
examples.trans: Walking at the entrance to Wutong Lane, you can smell the aroma of lemon tarts drifting from Room Nine from afar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: liáng. Note 2nd-tone reading liáng for the verb 'measure' (contrasting with 4th-tone noun 数量 shù liàng 'quantity').

examples.text: 志豪已经用尺子量过九号房的平面图了，里面刚好摆四张方木桌。
examples.trans: Hao has already measured Room Nine's floor plan with a ruler—four square wooden tables fit inside just right.

examples.text: 做烘焙讲究精确，小美总是仔细量好每一勺面粉和白糖。
examples.trans: Baking requires precision, so Mei always carefully measures every spoonful of flour and sugar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bāo. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片面包 ('a slice of bread').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Smell that! Warm bread, hot scrambled eggs, and fresh herbs.

related.gloss: a slice of bread (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn tuán. Measure word (量词): 团, e.g. 一团面团 ('a ball of dough').

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经放进去了。
examples.trans: My dough is already in the oven, at least.

examples.text: 揉好的面团放在温暖的地方醒发一小时。
examples.trans: Set the kneaded dough in a warm spot to rise for an hour.

related.gloss: a ball of dough (measure word 团)
